name: Counter
summary: The counter at 8 a.m., in a grand hotel's morning café: the café's own counter photo set in a tall brass-lined arch, each bake on it tagged live from the sheet (fresh out, sold out), with the line, order-ahead buttons, the open status and the visitor's usual beside it, then straight under it what's on the counter and the coffee board on an espresso card. Daylight oat walls, espresso ink, tiled teal-green with a tile frieze, brass hairlines and a butter tag for fresh trays; Gloock headings (no italics) with a hand-drawn brass underline, Onest for everything else; order-ticket buttons with an ink outline and a fine brass inner line that press in on tap. Leads with the counter, Your usual and the glass case; compact, scannable copy. For cafés, coffee houses and bakery-cafés.
